require "rails_helper"

describe TagCloud do
  describe "#tags" do
    it "returns proposal tags" do
      create(:proposal, tag_list: "participation")
      create(:debate,   tag_list: "world hunger")

      tag_cloud = TagCloud.new(Proposal)

      expect(tag_names(tag_cloud)).to contain_exactly("participation")
    end

    it "returns debate tags" do
      create(:proposal, tag_list: "participation")
      create(:debate,   tag_list: "world hunger")

      tag_cloud = TagCloud.new(Debate)

      expect(tag_names(tag_cloud)).to contain_exactly("world hunger")
    end

    it "returns budget investment tags" do
      create(:budget_investment, tag_list: "participation")
      create(:debate, tag_list: "world hunger")

      tag_cloud = TagCloud.new(Budget::Investment)

      expect(tag_names(tag_cloud)).to contain_exactly("participation")
    end

    it "returns tags from last week" do
      create(:proposal, tag_list: "participation", created_at: 1.day.ago)
      create(:proposal, tag_list: "corruption",    created_at: 2.weeks.ago)

      tag_cloud = TagCloud.new(Proposal)

      expect(tag_names(tag_cloud)).to contain_exactly("participation")
    end

    it "does not return category tags" do
      create(:tag, :category, name: "Education")
      create(:tag, :category, name: "Participation")

      create(:proposal, tag_list: "education, parks")
      create(:proposal, tag_list: "participation, water")

      tag_cloud = TagCloud.new(Proposal)

      expect(tag_names(tag_cloud)).to contain_exactly("parks", "water")
    end

    it "does not return geozone names" do
      create(:geozone, name: "California")
      create(:geozone, name: "New York")

      create(:proposal, tag_list: "parks, California")
      create(:proposal, tag_list: "water, New York")

      tag_cloud = TagCloud.new(Proposal)

      expect(tag_names(tag_cloud)).to contain_exactly("parks", "water")
    end

    it "returns tags scoped by category" do
      create(:tag, :category, name: "Education")
      create(:tag, :category, name: "Participation")

      create(:proposal, tag_list: "education, parks")
      create(:proposal, tag_list: "participation, water")

      tag_cloud = TagCloud.new(Proposal, "Education")

      expect(tag_names(tag_cloud)).to contain_exactly("parks")
    end

    it "returns tags scoped by geozone" do
      create(:geozone, name: "California")
      create(:geozone, name: "New York")

      create(:proposal, tag_list: "parks, California")
      create(:proposal, tag_list: "water, New York")

      tag_cloud = TagCloud.new(Proposal, "California")

      expect(tag_names(tag_cloud)).to contain_exactly("parks")
    end

    it "orders tags by count" do
      3.times { create(:proposal, tag_list: "participation") }
      create(:proposal, tag_list: "corruption")

      tag_cloud = TagCloud.new(Proposal)

      expect(tag_names(tag_cloud)).to eq ["participation", "corruption"]
    end

    it "orders tags by count and then by name" do
      3.times { create(:proposal, tag_list: "participation") }
      3.times { create(:proposal, tag_list: "health") }
      create(:proposal, tag_list: "corruption")

      tag_cloud = TagCloud.new(Proposal)

      expect(tag_names(tag_cloud)).to eq ["health", "participation", "corruption"]
    end

    it "returns a maximum of 10 tags" do
      12.times { |i| create(:proposal, tag_list: "Tag #{i}") }

      tag_cloud = TagCloud.new(Proposal)

      expect(tag_names(tag_cloud).count).to eq(10)
    end
  end
end
require "rails_helper"

describe Tag do
  it "decreases tag_count when a debate is hidden" do
    debate = create(:debate)
    tag = create(:tag, taggables: [debate])

    expect(tag.taggings_count).to eq(1)

    debate.update!(hidden_at: Time.current)

    tag.reload
    expect(tag.taggings_count).to eq(0)
  end

  it "decreases tag_count when a proposal is hidden" do
    proposal = create(:proposal)
    tag = create(:tag, taggables: [proposal])

    expect(tag.taggings_count).to eq(1)

    proposal.update!(hidden_at: Time.current)

    tag.reload
    expect(tag.taggings_count).to eq(0)
  end

  describe "name validation" do
    it "160 char name should be valid" do
      tag = build(:tag, name: Faker::Lorem.characters(number: 160))
      expect(tag).to be_valid
    end
  end

  context "Same tag uppercase and lowercase" do
    before do
      create(:tag, name: "Health")
      create(:tag, name: "health")

    it "assigns only one of the existing tags (we can't control which one)" do
      debate = create(:debate, tag_list: "Health")

      expect([["Health"], ["health"]]).to include debate.reload.tag_list
    end

    it "assigns existing tags instead of creating new similar ones" do
      debate = create(:debate, tag_list: "hEaLth")

      expect([["Health"], ["health"]]).to include debate.reload.tag_list
    end
  end
end

Now, I see the `GET /proposals` request is hitting `PagesController#show`—seems right because the route is configured (`resources :pages, path: "/"`)—and it's returning a 404 because "proposals" isn't a defined page. Excellent! This gives me an opportunity to verify not only that endpoint, but all the other endpoints as well. The common set of unauthenticated endpoints, and also the authenticated endpoints (admin, moderator, user profile, notifications, account). I'll ensure I pass `"REMOTE_ADDR" => "127.0.0.1"` in all of those tests.

Hold on, I need to be careful about polluting my `consul_development` database with test data. Creating Ahoy `Visit` rows during testing is something I need to avoid. Let's not make test data permanent! I could either wrap the test in a rolled-back transaction, or check `Visit.count` before and after. Actually, I like the rolled-back transaction approach better! A robust solution is to use `ActiveRecord::Base.transaction { ... raise ActiveRecord::Rollback }`. This will ensure that any `Visit` or `Widget::Feed` inserts, or anything else, will be rolled back, keeping `consul_development` pristine. I'll wrap all of these tests in a rolled-back transaction. That's the way to go!

Okay, here's my take on those initial thoughts, framed as my own:

**Initial Project Status & Linter Kickoff**

Excellent! The asset precompilation passed without a hitch. That's always a good sign. No errors there to muddy the waters. Now it's time to really dig in and make sure the codebase is shipshape. Let's get the linters running. I'm hitting `rubocop` specifically on the changed files to check Ruby code style. Then, I'm firing off `erb_lint` to ensure my ERB templates are clean. After that, I'll need `eslint` and `stylelint` to check JavaScript and CSS, respectively. And finally, I'll use `htmlbeautifier` on the changed files to ensure the HTML is nicely formatted. This is the stage where I start ensuring code quality, adhering to project standards and best practices, and catching potential issues early before they can fester. This should keep everything tidy.

arguments.command:
cd /app && \
CHANGED_RB=$(git status --porcelain | awk '$1 != "D" && $2 ~ /\.rb$/ {print $2}') && \
CHANGED_ERB=$(git status --porcelain | awk '$1 != "D" && $2 ~ /\.html\.erb$/ {print $2}') && \
echo "=== RuboCop ===" && bundle exec rubocop --fail-level convention --display-only-fail-level-offenses $CHANGED_RB && \
echo "=== ERB Lint ===" && bundle exec erb_lint $CHANGED_ERB && \
echo "=== HTML Beautifier ===" && for f in $CHANGED_ERB; do bundle exec htmlbeautifier --lint-only --keep-blank-lines 1 "$f" || exit 1; done && \
echo "=== ESLint ===" && npx eslint . --quiet && \
echo "=== Stylelint ===" && npx stylelint app/assets/stylesheets

echo "=== Stylelint ===" && npx stylelint app/assets/stylesheets

1. **Zero downtime:** Every deploy runs alongside the previous release while migrations execute. Never drop a table or column while the previous release still reads or writes it.
2. **Backup before removal:** Before any table, column, or database record is dropped or deleted, dump its contents into a file under `db/` and keep that file.

messages.thinking:
Okay, here's my take on those thoughts, tailored for an expert audience:

**MDL Indentation Conundrum**

Right, so I was digging into why my Markdown linting was failing on those nested lists. Ah, *that's* it! The `.mdl_style.rb` file is enforcing an indent of 2 spaces (`indent: 2`) for all list items, thanks to that `rule "MD007"` configuration. The problem is that ordered lists formatted with `1.` require a 3-space indent for the nested bullet points (e.g., `   *`), but unordered lists using `*` only need a 2-space indent (e.g., `  *`) to be correct. The linter seems to be incorrectly flagging the REMOVAL.md doc.

Okay, let's fix the indentation in `docs/REMOVAL.md` to align with the indent level required for the unordered lists that I am using, and then run `bundle exec mdl docs/` to verify that everything now passes, and my documentation is now correct. Easy fix, moving on!

arguments.command:
cd /app && ruby -e '
c = File.read("docs/REMOVAL.md")
c.gsub!(/^( +)\* /, "  \\1* ")
# Actually check nested levels: 2 spaces for level 1 under *, 4 spaces for level 2, 3 spaces under "1."
lines = c.lines.map do |line|
  if line.start_with?("    * ")
    line.sub("    * ", "   * ")
  else
    line
  end
end
File.write("docs/REMOVAL.md", lines.join)
' && ruby -e '
# Better: set explicit 2-space indent under * and 3-space indent under numbered items
lines = File.read("docs/REMOVAL.md").lines
out = []
in_numbered = false
lines.each do |l|
  if l =~ /^\d+\. /
    in_numbered = true
    out << l
  elsif l =~ /^\* / || l =~ /^#/ || l.strip.empty?
    in_numbered = false if l =~ /^#/ || l =~ /^\* /
    out << l
  elsif l =~ /^ +(\* .*)/
    spaces = l[/^ +/].size
    if in_numbered
      if spaces <= 4
        out << "   #{$1}\n"
      else
        out << "     #{$1}\n"
      end
    else
      if spaces <= 3
        out << "  #{$1}\n"
      else
        out << "    #{$1}\n"
      end
    end
  else
    out << l
  end
end
File.write("docs/REMOVAL.md", out.join)
' && bundle exec mdl docs/REMOVAL.md

# Citizen Proposals Removal Plan

This document tracks the three-deploy, zero-downtime retirement of citizen proposals (`Proposal`), proposal notifications (`ProposalNotification`), the proposal authors' dashboard (`Dashboard::*`), and their associated admin, moderation, and management interfaces.

`Legislation::Proposal` is a separate feature and stays intact.

## Ground Rules

1. **Zero downtime:** Every deploy runs alongside the previous release while migrations execute. Never drop a table or column while the previous release still reads or writes it.
2. **Backup before removal:** Before any table, column, or database record is dropped or deleted, dump its contents into a file under `db/` and keep that file.
3. **Scope:** Do not alter unrelated features. Keep `Legislation::Proposal` and the two shared settings it uses (`max_votes_for_proposal_edit`, `proposal_code_prefix`).

---

## Deploy 1 — Code Removal

**Status:** Prepared (pending ship).

### What Changed in Deploy 1

* **Routes removed:**
  * Deleted `config/routes/proposal.rb` and `draw :proposal` from `config/routes.rb`.
  * Removed citizen proposal, hidden proposal, hidden proposal notification, dashboard (`actions`, `administrator_tasks`), `stats#proposal_notifications`, and `system_emails` (`preview_pending`, `moderate_pending`, `send_pending`) routes from `config/routes/admin.rb`.
  * Removed `proposals` routes from `config/routes/management.rb`.
  * Removed `proposals` and `proposal_notifications` routes from `config/routes/moderation.rb` (kept `moderation/legislation/proposals`).
  * Removed `proposal_notifications` route from `config/routes/notification.rb`.
* **Models & Concerns removed/updated:**
  * Deleted `app/models/proposal.rb`, `app/models/proposal/exporter.rb`, `app/models/proposal_notification.rb`, `app/models/dashboard.rb`, `app/models/dashboard/*`.
  * Deleted `app/lib/email_digest.rb` (only used for `proposal_notification_digest`).
  * Updated `User`, `Poll`, `Poll::Question`, `MapLocation`, `Community`, `Comment`, `Milestone`, `Notification`, `Notifiable`, `Activity`, `RelatedContent`, `Relationable`, `SignatureSheet`, `Setting`, `Widget::Feed`, `Geozone`, `I18nContent`, `Ahoy::Chart`, `SDG::Related`, `Taggable`, `TagCloud`, `MachineLearning`, and `Abilities::*` (`Everyone`, `Common`, `Moderation`, `Moderator`, `Administrator`).
  * Kept `Setting` defaults `max_votes_for_proposal_edit` and `proposal_code_prefix` because `Legislation::Proposal` uses them.
* **Controllers, Helpers, Mailers, GraphQL:**
  * Deleted `ProposalsController`, `ProposalNotificationsController`, `DashboardController`, `Dashboard::*`, `Concerns::Dashboard::*`, `Admin::ProposalsController`, `Admin::HiddenProposalsController`, `Admin::HiddenProposalNotificationsController`, `Admin::ProposalMilestonesController`, `Admin::ProposalProgressBarsController`, `Admin::Dashboard::*` (kept `Admin::DashboardController` which is the admin landing page), `Management::ProposalsController`, `Moderation::ProposalsController`, `Moderation::ProposalNotificationsController`.
  * Deleted `ProposalsHelper`, `ProposalsDashboardHelper`, `Admin::ProposalDashboardActionsHelper`, `Dashboard::Mailer`, `Types::ProposalType`, `Types::ProposalNotificationType`.
  * Updated `Admin::Poll::QuestionsController`, `Admin::StatsController`, `Admin::SystemEmailsController`, `Admin::ActivityController`, `Admin::HomepageController`, `Admin::HiddenCommentsController`, `Admin::HiddenUsersController`, `Moderation::CommentsController`, `CommunitiesController`, `TopicsController`, `PollsController`, `WelcomeController`, `AccountController`, `SubscriptionsController`, `Management::UsersController`, `Concerns::CommentableActions`, `CommunitiesHelper`, `SignatureSheetsHelper`, `SiteCustomizationHelper`, `UsersHelper`, `WelcomeHelper`, `Mailer`, `UserSegments`, `Types::QueryType`, `Types::UserType`.
* **Views, Components, Assets, Initializers, Seeds, Locales:**
  * Deleted proposal, proposal notification, and author dashboard views/components/assets (`app/views/proposals`, `app/views/proposal_notifications`, `app/views/dashboard`, `app/views/layouts/dashboard*`, `app/views/admin/proposals`, `app/views/admin/hidden_proposal*`, `app/views/admin/dashboard/actions`, `app/views/admin/dashboard/administrator_tasks`, `app/views/management/proposals`, `app/views/moderation/proposals`, `app/views/moderation/proposal_notifications`, `app/components/proposals`, `app/components/dashboard`, `app/components/admin/proposals`, `app/components/admin/dashboard/actions`, `app/components/admin/settings/proposals_dashboard_tab_component*`, `app/components/widget/feeds/proposal_component*`, etc.).
  * Fixed `app/views/legislation/proposals/_proposal.html.erb` (removed `Proposal.votes_needed_for_success`) and `app/components/legislation/proposals/votes_component.html.erb` (changed `proposal_url` to `legislation_process_proposal_url`) so legislation proposals keep working.
  * Updated `app/components/shared/tag_list_component.rb` to handle `Budget::Investment` routes.

Spanish (`es`) will be updated by translators later.

### Zero-Downtime Safeguards Added in Deploy 1

1. **`ignored_columns` on remaining models** (for columns to be dropped in Deploy 2 / Deploy 3):
   * `User`: `recommended_proposals`, `email_digest`, `failed_email_digests_count`
   * `ActsAsTaggableOn::Tag` (in `config/initializers/acts_as_taggable_on.rb`): `proposals_count`
   * `Poll`: `related_type`, `related_id`
   * `Poll::Question`: `proposal_id`
   * `MapLocation`: `proposal_id`
2. **Transitional guards against existing proposal rows in the unmigrated database:**
   * `Poll.created_by_admin` (`where(related_type: nil)`) kept and also applied in `PollsController#load_poll` and `Admin::StatsController#polls` so existing `related_type = 'Proposal'` polls stay hidden during Deploy 1 and Deploy 2's migration.
   * `Notification.excluding_proposals` applied to `Notification.read` and `Notification.unread` to skip `Proposal`, `ProposalNotification`, and `Comment` on `Proposal` rows.
   * `Activity.for_render` excludes `actionable_type: %w[Proposal ProposalNotification]`.
   * `Moderation::CommentsController`, `Admin::HiddenCommentsController`, `Admin::HiddenUsersController`, and `Users::PublicActivityComponent` filter comments to `Comment::COMMENTABLE_TYPES` (or exclude `"Proposal"`).
   * `User#interests` and `Users::PublicActivityComponent#follows` exclude `followable_type: "Proposal"`.
   * `Relationable#relationed_contents` excludes `child_relationable_type: "Proposal"`.
   * `SDG::Related#relatables` excludes `relatable_type: "Proposal"`.
   * `Admin::HomepageController` scopes `Widget::Feed` to `Widget::Feed::KINDS`.
   * `Admin::Banners::FormComponent` excludes `WebSection` `"proposals"`.
   * `TopicsController#load_community` returns 404 if `@community.investment.blank?`.

---

## Left for Next Time

### Deploy 2 — Data Dumps, Data Cleanup, and Schema Drops

**Prerequisites:** Deploy 1 has shipped to all servers (so no running server reads or writes proposal tables, proposal columns, or proposal polymorphic rows, EXCEPT `Poll.created_by_admin` still checks `polls.related_type IS NULL`).

1. **Dump all retired tables, columns, and related rows to files under `db/` before deleting/dropping anything** (including across any tenant schemas if multitenancy is used):
   * **Tables to dump and drop:**
     * `proposals`
     * `proposal_translations`
     * `proposal_notifications`
     * `dashboard_actions`
     * `dashboard_administrator_tasks`
     * `dashboard_executed_actions`
   * **Columns on remaining tables to dump and drop in Deploy 2:**
     * `users`: `recommended_proposals`, `email_digest`, `failed_email_digests_count`
     * `tags`: `proposals_count`
     * `poll_questions`: `proposal_id` (and foreign key `poll_questions -> proposals`, index `index_poll_questions_on_proposal_id`)
     * `map_locations`: `proposal_id` (and index `index_map_locations_on_proposal_id`)
     * *(Defer dropping `polls.related_type` and `polls.related_id` to Deploy 3 because Deploy 1 servers still run `WHERE polls.related_type IS NULL` during Deploy 2's migration window.)*
   * **Polymorphic / dependent rows in remaining tables to dump and delete in Deploy 2:**
     * `polls` where `related_type = 'Proposal'` and their dependent records (`poll_translations`, `poll_questions`, `poll_question_translations`, `poll_question_answers`, `poll_question_answer_translations`, `poll_question_answer_videos`, `poll_answers`, `poll_voters`, `poll_recounts`, `poll_partial_results`, `poll_ballot_sheets`, `poll_ballots`, `geozones_polls`, `votation_types` for those questions).
     * `communities` that belong to `proposals` (not `budget_investments`), and `topics` belonging to those communities.
     * `comments` (and `comment_translations`) where `commentable_type = 'Proposal'` OR (`commentable_type = 'Topic'` for deleted proposal topics).
     * `votes` where `votable_type = 'Proposal'` OR (`votable_type = 'Comment'` for deleted comments).
     * `flags` where `flaggable_type IN ('Proposal', 'ProposalNotification')` OR (`flaggable_type = 'Comment'` for deleted comments).
     * `follows` where `followable_type = 'Proposal'`.
     * `activities` where `actionable_type IN ('Proposal', 'ProposalNotification')` OR (`actionable_type = 'Comment'` for deleted comments).
     * `notifications` where `notifiable_type IN ('Proposal', 'ProposalNotification')` OR (`notifiable_type = 'Comment'` for deleted comments). Update affected users' `notifications_count` counter cache.
     * `related_contents` and `related_content_scores` where `parent_relationable_type = 'Proposal'` OR `child_relationable_type = 'Proposal'`.
     * `taggings` where `taggable_type = 'Proposal'`, and recompute `tags.taggings_count`.
     * `milestones` (+ `milestone_translations`), `progress_bars` (+ `progress_bar_translations`), `documents`, `images`, `links`, `ml_summary_comments`, `remote_translations`, `reports`, `sdg_relations`, `sdg_reviews`, `signature_sheets` (+ `signatures`), `audits`, `active_storage_attachments` (and blobs if unreferenced) pointing to `Proposal`, `ProposalNotification`, `Dashboard::Action`, `Dashboard::AdministratorTask`, `Dashboard::ExecutedAction`, or deleted proposal polls/comments/topics.
     * `settings` rows for retired proposal/dashboard keys (do **not** delete `max_votes_for_proposal_edit` or `proposal_code_prefix`).
     * `web_sections` row where `name = 'proposals'` (and any `banner_sections` pointing to it).
     * `widget_feeds` rows where `kind = 'proposals'`.
     * `i18n_contents` (+ `i18n_content_translations`) for retired `proposals.*` keys (keep keys still used by `Legislation::Proposal`, `MapLocation`, `EmbeddedVideoComponent`, `SearchResultsSummaryComponent`).
2. **Code update in Deploy 2:**
   * Remove `Poll.created_by_admin` (`where(related_type: nil)`) and all `.created_by_admin` calls in `PollsController`, `Admin::Poll::PollsController`, and `Admin::StatsController` so Deploy 3 can safely drop `polls.related_type` and `polls.related_id`.

### Deploy 3 — Final Tidying

**Prerequisites:** Deploy 2 has shipped to all servers (all proposal tables, columns, and polymorphic rows are gone, and no running server queries `polls.related_type`).

1. Dump (verify empty) and drop `polls.related_type` and `polls.related_id` (and `index_polls_on_related_type_and_related_id`).
2. Remove `self.ignored_columns` entries added for this removal from `User`, `ActsAsTaggableOn::Tag`, `Poll`, `Poll::Question`, and `MapLocation`.
3. Remove Deploy 1's transitional polymorphic guards (`Notification.excluding_proposals`, `Activity.for_render` `where.not`, `Moderation::CommentsController#load_resources` override, `Admin::HiddenCommentsController` & `Admin::HiddenUsersController` `commentable_type` filters, `Users::PublicActivityComponent` `"Proposal"` exclusion and `where.not` on `follows`, `User#interests` `where.not`, `Relationable#relationed_contents` `where.not`, `SDG::Related#relatables` `where.not`, `Admin::HomepageController` `where(kind: ...)`, `Admin::Banners::FormComponent` `where.not`).
4. Update `docs/REMOVAL.md` to mark the removal complete.
